Mr. Kwon 将签署一份位于 624 Livingston Road 大楼内公寓的租约。
A. of
B. by
C. like
D. for

items.question: Mr. Kwon will sign a lease ----- an apartment in the building at 624 Livingston Road.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“for”代入题干后为“Mr. Kwon will sign a lease for an apartment in the building at 624 Livingston Road.”。选择理由：该项符合空格处所需的介词或固定搭配，并使句意完整。正确答案：D（for）。
